```{r}
 
dol <- function(ga, thetab, betaB, gb, betamin, gmin, mA, mB,
                thetaa, Pa, Pb, betaA, d, A0, B0, a0, b0, times) {

  library(deSolve)

  dol_equations <- function(time, variables, parameters) {
    with(as.list(c(variables, parameters)), {

      dA <- A * (ga * thetab * gb * betaB * betamin * gmin - mA)
      dB <- B * (gb * thetaa * ga * betaA * betamin * gmin - mB)
      da <- A * Pa - A * ga - d * (A * thetaa - B * betaA * ga)
      db <- B * Pb - B * gb - d * (B * thetab - A * betaB * gb)

      list(c(dA, dB, da, db))
    })
    
  }

  parameters_values <- c(
    ga = ga, thetab = thetab, betaB = betaB, gb = gb,
    betamin = betamin, gmin = gmin, mA = mA, mB = mB,
    thetaa = thetaa, Pa = Pa, Pb = Pb, betaA = betaA, d = d
  )

  initial_values <- c(A = A0, B = B0, a = a0, b = b0)

  out <- ode(y = initial_values, times = times, func = dol_equations, parms = parameters_values)

  as.data.frame(out)
}

dol_values <- dol(
ga      = 0.05,
gb      = 0.1,
betaA   = 0.015,
betaB   = 0.08,
betamin = 0.001,
gmin    = 0.001,
mA      = 0.0001,
mB      = 0.0001,
d       = 0.1,
A0      = 100,
B0      = 100,
a0      = 0,
b0      = 0,
thetaa = .001,
thetab = .016,
Pa = .1,
Pb =.1,
times = seq(0,1000))


#Plot
ggplot(dol_values, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = A, color = "SpeciesA")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = B, color = "SpeciesB")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = a, color = "Resourcea")) +
  geom_line(aes(y=b, color = "Resourceb"))+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      SpeciesA = "blue",
      SpeciesB = "red",
      Resourcea = "black",
      Resourceb = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Abundance",
    color = NULL
  )
```

```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)

crossfeed_model <- function(t, state, parms) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parms)), {

    # Saturation terms
    phi_a <- a / (Ka + a)
    phi_b <- b / (Kb + b)

    # Consumer growth
    dCA <- CA * (muA * min(phi_a, phi_b) - mA)
    dCB <- CB * (muB * min(phi_a, phi_b) - mB)

    # Resource dynamics
    dRa <- CA * Pa - CA * ua * phi_a - CB * thetaA * muBa * phi_a
    dRb <- CB * Pb - CB * ub * phi_b - CA * thetaB * muAb * phi_b

    list(c(dCA, dCB, dRa, dRb))
  })
  
}

state <- c(
  CA = 1,
  CB = 1,
  a = 0.9,
  b = 0.5
)

parms <- c(
  muA = 1.0,
  muB = 1.0,
  mA  = 0.01,
  mB  = 0.1,
  Ka  = 0.2,
  Kb  = 0.2,
  Pa  = 0.05,
  Pb  = 0.05,
  ua  = 0.4,
  ub  = 0.4,
  thetaA = 0.6,
  thetaB = 0.3,
  muBa = 0.7,
  muAb = 0.7
)

times <- seq(0, 200, by = 0.1)

out <- ode(y = state, times = times, func = crossfeed_model, parms = parms)

    




ggplot(dol_values, aes(x = time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CA, color = "SpeciesA"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = CB, color = "SpeciesB"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = a,  color = "Resourcea"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = b,  color = "Resourceb"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      SpeciesA = "blue",
      SpeciesB = "red",
      Resourcea = "black",
      Resourceb = "grey"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Abundance",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
